note: Independent re-audit after 26d70dfa0d. On the normal paths the tags still hold: the zero-GR real-RIB root requires the received NO_LLGR route absent while its sibling stays at level 2 with LLGR_STALE; TestDeleteWithCommunity and the LLGR_STALE-only negative pin exact community matching; the best-path pair requires the Withdraw; llgr-import-no-llgr.ci covers the policy-marked case on a real daemon. removeNoLLGR now wraps the same delete-with-community command, and restalePreservedLLGR repeats it on every retained connection at a consecutive DOWN; removePhysicalSource only gains forgetEarlier on a complete release. FINDING, single restart: llgrFamilyActive now returns false once a successor re-established, and onLLGREnter checks it before step 1. If the successor's UP is handled after the Restart Time expired but before the entry callback dispatches NO_LLGR removal, the LLGR period has begun yet NO_LLGR routes stay retained as stale through synchronization, until End-of-RIB, LLST expiry or a later DOWN. Section 4.2 says they MUST NOT be retained once that period begins. No tagged root can fail on this; before the commit the guard read only the family's timer and the removal ran. Suspected code defect, not verified by a run.
